texts.preamble: Rakesh Kumar Nahata vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 25 September, 2019 Author: Rumi Kumari Phukan Bench: Rumi Kumari Phukan Page N Gahc010235472019 The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) Case No. : Crl.Pet. 1137/2019 1:Rakesh Kumar Nahata S/O Late Gambhirmal Nahata, R/O Shanti Niketan, Jail Road, Fancy Bazar, Guwahati-01 Versus 1:The State Of Assam And Anr. Represented By The Public Prosecutor, Assam 2:The Food Safety Officer Kamrup (M) Office Of The Joint Director Of Health Services Uzanbazar Guwahati-0 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. S Chamaria Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam Before Honourable Mrs. Justice Rumi Kumari Phukan Order Date : 25-09-2019 Rakesh Kumar Nahata vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 25 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76655179/ 1 The present petitioner who has been arrayed an as accused in CR Case No.2487/2019 under Sections 26(1)(2)(i) read with Section 59 of the Food and Safety Page No.# 2/2 and Standard Act, 2006, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati has challenged the entire proceeding on the ground that the petitioner has been wrongly arrayed as an accused in the aforesaid complaint case whereas the company itself has not arrayed him as an accused in the said case. It is contended that the petitioner is one of the Director of the company and his role is also not specifically mentioned in the complaint petition.
texts.facts: The present petitioner who has been arrayed an as accused in CR Case No.2487/2019 under Sections 26(1)(2)(i) read with Section 59 of the Food and Safety Page No.# 2/2 and Standard Act, 2006, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati has challenged the entire proceeding on the ground that the petitioner has been wrongly arrayed as an accused in the aforesaid complaint case whereas the company itself has not arrayed him as an accused in the said case. It is contended that the petitioner is one of the Director of the company and his role is also not specifically mentioned in the complaint petition.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prosecution was initiated without considering as to whether the petitioner herein is a designated person under section Page No.# 3/3 66 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prosecution was initiated without considering as to whether the petitioner herein is a designated person under section Page No.# 3/3 66 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
